source.title: Rules and mechanisms for efficient two-stage learning in neural circuits.

confidence_rationale: Computational/theoretical model formalizing the songbird two-stage architecture: a basal-ganglia tutor circuit (LMAN) injects exploratory variability AND a corrective bias, gradually consolidated into a separate motor (RA) student circuit. Supports the architectural separation of a variability/diversity generator from the committed motor output -- the structural premise behind locating MECH-442's archive upstream of / parallel to the commit. Capped because it is a model (not a measurement) and addresses tutor-student consolidation, not per-niche-elite retention.
failure_signatures: The diversity here is a variability-injection-plus-corrective-bias mechanism (explore then consolidate), not a per-niche-elite archive that survives selection -- so it supports the generator/selector separation, not the specific MAP-Elites structure.

Mismatches between the tutor (variability) signal and the student plasticity rule impair learning -- a warning that an REE diversity-injection coupled to the committed selector must be matched to the downstream learning rule or it degrades performance.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In songbird learning, the basal-ganglia-related circuit LMAN both induces vocal exploration (variability) and contributes a corrective bias to the motor output, which is gradually consolidated in the downstream motor-cortex analog RA; an efficient two-stage learner requires the tutor's teaching signal to match the student's plasticity mechanism.
mapping.ree_translation: The diversity-generating structure (REE: ARC-065 generation + MECH-313 variability) is architecturally SEPARATE from and upstream of the committed motor selector, and its output is consolidated downstream over time -- supporting MECH-442's framing of the archive as a generation-side / parallel structure feeding a commit, rather than a per-niche store read at the argmax.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a model of tutor-student variability consolidation, not a measurement of per-niche-elite retention; it supports the separation-of-generator-from-selector architecture but is agnostic between a MAP-Elites archive and a simpler variability-injection-plus-bias account.
mapping.source_context: Theoretical/computational model of the songbird LMAN->RA two-stage learning circuit, with reinforcement-learning derivation of the tutor signal.

confidence_components.notes: Solid eLife theory paper; mapping_fidelity moderate (architecture-level support for generator/selector separation, not the per-niche mechanism); transfer_risk moderate (songbird circuit model to REE E3/selection).
